Map.dc.html.title: Map · owner on every node (A, chosen)

brief.text:
OWNER: one accountable name per project, so management knows who to call. Picked from the directory or typed. Stored as plain text, never a link to a person. No filter by owner, no "my projects".

CHALLENGE: free text per phase, raising something that needs discussion. It may block, it may not; the text says which. Empty means none. No severity, no resolved tick. Drawn on Portfolio and Map, never derived: no rule, stage, warning or date reads it.

Both travel in /api/export. Changes to both are logged in item_version, so the hover can say who raised it and when.
